holder-quote: He fired a jet black beam of energy at Zel’s head.
effect-quote: His blow caught the Necromancer on the chest and tore through whatever protection the mage had on him.

holder-quote: Zel’s claws went through a barrier of magic and into the Goblin Lord’s side.
effect-quote: Zel’s claws went through a barrier of magic and into the Goblin Lord’s side. He tore—the Goblin Lord screamed as Zel ripped his stomach open.

holder-quote: He walked over to Zel, his hands reaching out to touch the Drake’s chest. The Goblin Lord saw Zel’s eyes flicker, saw the Drake’s claws move.
effect-quote: The cut was fast. It scythed through the almost-invisible aura of protection around the Necromancer’s body, cut into his neck—but only just.
